state.work: The current implementation task is unfinished and its next code change is known.
state.working_tree: Current local changes are expected and understood.
state.analysis: The project state was checked after the latest source changes.

paraphrase: The task stopped before completion, but the exact next implementation step is already known. Tests are green, local edits are understood, and the project understanding reflects the latest source.
korean: 현재 구현 작업은 아직 끝나지 않았지만 다음 코드 변경이 명확합니다. 관련 테스트는 통과했고 로컬 변경은 모두 의도된 것이며 최신 소스 기준으로 프로젝트 상태도 확인되었습니다.

state.work: The current task is active and has a concrete next implementation step.
state.tests: No blocking test failure is known.
state.working_tree: The working tree is dirty because of the current task; every changed file is understood.
state.analysis: The saved project understanding includes these local changes.
state.direction: The direction remains active and confirmed.

paraphrase: There are uncommitted edits, but they all belong to the current unfinished task. The next step is clear and nothing indicates that the project understanding is stale.
korean: 커밋되지 않은 변경이 있지만 모두 현재 작업에서 만든 것으로 이해되고 있습니다. 작업은 미완료이며 다음 단계가 분명하고 기존 프로젝트 이해도 여전히 최신입니다.

state.work: A previous task appears to have stopped.
state.tests: No blocking test failure is known.
state.working_tree: Several source files changed locally and their origin is unknown.
state.analysis: The project analysis itself is recent.

paraphrase: Unexpected uncommitted source edits are present and nobody has established why they exist. The stored project understanding is otherwise recent.
korean: 예상하지 못한 소스 파일 변경이 로컬에 있으며 왜 생겼는지 확인되지 않았습니다. 프로젝트 분석 자체는 최근 상태입니다.

state.work: The current task cannot be safely resumed yet.
state.tests: Test status is not useful until repository state is resolved.
state.working_tree: A merge conflict is present in files related to the current task.
state.analysis: The high-level project understanding is recent.

paraphrase: The project has unresolved merge conflicts in task-related files. The work direction is still valid, but the repository state must be understood first.

state.work: No next implementation step should be chosen from the old project understanding.
state.working_tree: The refactor is intentional and fully understood.
state.analysis: The saved project analysis predates a major architecture refactor.

paraphrase: A large intentional refactor changed the architecture after the current project analysis was created. The repository changes are understood, but the old analysis no longer describes the project.
korean: 대규모 리팩터링은 의도된 변경이며 모두 이해되고 있지만 현재 프로젝트 분석은 리팩터링 이전 구조를 설명하고 있어 더 이상 신뢰할 수 없습니다.

state.work: The saved next step belongs to the previously checked source state.
state.working_tree: The current repository state is clean and understood.
state.analysis: The project moved to a substantially different branch after the saved analysis.
state.direction: The current direction is still valid.

paraphrase: The workspace moved to a substantially different branch after the last analysis, so the saved next step is based on a different source state.

state.work: The current delegated work has finished.
state.result: A completed result is ready for the current work item.
state.dependencies: One later task depends on accepting or rejecting this result.

paraphrase: The current delegated task returned a completed result, and another task depends on what that result contains. It should be checked before moving on.
korean: 현재 위임된 작업의 완료 결과가 도착했으며 이후 작업 하나가 이 결과의 확인에 의존합니다. 다음으로 넘어가기 전에 결과를 검토해야 합니다.

state.work: The current delegated work stopped with a failure.
state.result: The failure report is available for review.
state.dependencies: Dependent work cannot proceed until the failure is understood.

paraphrase: A delegated task failed and left a failure report. Work that comes after it is blocked until somebody reviews what happened.

state.work: The current work is waiting for an already running verification.
state.process: The verification is still running normally.
state.alternatives: No independent low-cost work is available.

paraphrase: A required check is already running and has not failed. There is no useful independent task to switch to while it finishes.
korean: 필수 검증이 이미 정상적으로 실행 중이며 아직 실패하지 않았습니다. 그동안 전환해서 진행할 만한 독립 작업도 없습니다.

state.work: The selected work is waiting on an external dependency.
state.process: Nothing local can unblock the selected work right now.
state.alternatives: Another active work item is independent and has a saved return point.
state.direction: Both work items belong to the confirmed direction.

paraphrase: The selected task cannot move until an external dependency changes, while a separate task can be resumed cheaply from a saved return point.

state.connection: The project source is disconnected and cannot be inspected.
state.work: Only the last saved work context is available.
state.analysis: Current project state cannot be checked.

paraphrase: The source connection is unavailable, so only saved context remains and the live project cannot be checked.
korean: 프로젝트 소스 연결이 끊겨 현재 상태를 확인할 수 없고 마지막으로 저장된 작업 맥락만 남아 있습니다.

state.work: Three unfinished work items are available and none is selected as current.
state.direction: All three work items belong to the confirmed direction.

paraphrase: Several unfinished tasks are available under the current direction, but there is no current selection that tells the system which one should continue.
korean: 현재 방향 아래에 미완료 작업이 여러 개 있지만 어떤 작업을 현재 작업으로 이어갈지 선택되어 있지 않습니다.

state.work: No current work is selected.
state.direction: There is no confirmed active direction.
state.repository: The repository itself is available and healthy.

paraphrase: The project can be inspected normally, but there is no confirmed active direction that tells the system what work should be pursued.

state.work: An active current work item exists.
state.direction: The current direction conflicts with a recorded project constraint.
state.constraint: The conflict is still open and has not been explicitly overridden.

paraphrase: The active work points in a direction that conflicts with a recorded project constraint, and nobody has approved continuing despite that conflict.
korean: 현재 작업 방향이 기록된 프로젝트 제약과 충돌하며 이 충돌을 무시하고 계속하겠다는 명시적 결정도 아직 없습니다.

state.work: The current work is complete.
state.release: Delivery has a confirmed problem that needs attention.
state.next_work: No more important work is queued ahead of the release issue.

paraphrase: Current implementation work is done, but delivery has a confirmed problem and there is no more urgent queued work ahead of it.
korean: 현재 구현 작업은 완료되었지만 배포에 확인된 문제가 있으며 그보다 먼저 처리해야 할 다른 작업은 없습니다.

state.work: The selected work is still recorded as active.
state.proposal: Fresh project evidence says the work appears done.

paraphrase: The durable work record still says active, while fresh project evidence suggests the task has actually finished and should be checked for completion.

state.work: The selected work has a saved return point.
state.return_point: The saved return point was recorded before the current checked project state.
state.match: No explicit current interpretation confirms that the old return point still applies.

paraphrase: A saved resume point exists, but the project has changed since it was recorded and no explicit fresh match confirms that its old plan is still valid.

state.work: The selected work is complete.
state.next_work: Exactly one active next-after relation points to a ready unfinished work item.

paraphrase: The current task is finished and the work plan already names one ready task that should follow it next.

state.work: The selected work is complete.
state.direction: The current direction is still active.

paraphrase: The current task has finished, the direction remains active, and the plan does not already contain a next task.

state.work: The current implementation task is unfinished and its next step is known.
state.working_tree: Only an expected documentation file changed after the last check.
state.analysis: The source code and architecture described by the analysis did not change.

paraphrase: A documentation-only edit happened after the last check, but code and architecture stayed the same and the unfinished implementation still has a clear next step.
